text:
sara: Quick callout 1— we need to finalize the MVP cutlist today. We're juggling demo needs vs. launch risk. Current candidates: tenant SSO (heavy), embeddings cache (cheap win), model-pinning UI (core), in-console evals (sales-facing). Thoughts?

eva: My read: keep model-pinning, ship embeddings cache as opt-in, move in-console evals to v1. SSO is a separate sales-heavy lift 1— pilot later.

mike: Agree. Embeddings cache gives clear unit-economy wins. We can ship as a feature flag + 10% canary. Effort: ~3 dev days + 1d ops for metrics.

toni: Sales/UX note: losing in-console evals weakens the "quality guardrails" story. If we postpone, we should add a clear pilot path and note in the pitch deck: "evaluations coming in v1".

sara: Good point, toni. But we also can't risk stability. Proposal: MVP = model-pinning + embeddings cache (canary). v1 = in-console evals + long-retention telemetry. SSO to pilot.

mike: For canary criteria: token delta <= -10% after 24h, no p95 latency regression > 20%, error-rate < 0.5%. If any fail, auto-disable.
eva: I'll update the external-facing docs and add "pilot SSO" signup link.

toni: I'll prep the deck change and a short script for sales to use during demos.

sara: Ops: need runbook entries and an auto-disable hook. ops-bot: please create tickets.

ops-bot: Created tickets: INF-6221 (auto-disable runbook), QA-312 (canary test matrix), DOC-98 (sales pilot language).

mike: I'll add the feature-flag and canary dashboard. Also adding a rollback script in the PR template.
sara: Timeline: milestone freeze in 6 days (1777940000). Need engineering signoff in 48h. QA to validate test matrix before sign-off.
eva: Sales & marketing will have updated materials ready in 24h.
toni: QA, please confirm the list of regression cases we'll need for the canary.

ops-bot: Reminder: milestone freeze in 6 days. Automated reminder will post 48h before freeze.

sara: Action items summary: (1) mike: cache PR + canary dashboard (24h), (2) ops: runbook + auto-disable (2d), (3) toni: deck + demo script (24h), (4) eva: docs + pilot signup (24h), (5) QA: test matrix (48h). Engineering sign-off target: 48h.
eva: Ack.
mike: Ack.
toni: Ack.
ops-bot: All assignees notified.
